name: Omoigawa Ryouta
source:
His favourite food: Meat and potatoes, stir-fried vegetables.
His disliked food: Enoki Mushrooms.
The subject he lectures: Japanese Language.

The only full-time teacher at Konoegahara Gakuen, and Hiroto's class Homeroom teacher. Instead of appearing personally at the school, he talks to the students and school staff through a weird low polygon hologram of his face. He is a married man with kid(s).

[Translated from [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%AD%A6%E2%98%86%E7%8E%8B_-THE_ROYAL_SEVEN_STARS-#.E3.82.B5.E3.83.96.E3.82.AD.E3.83.A3.E3.83.A9.E3.82.AF.E3.82.BF.E3.83.BC]the Japanese Wikipedia[/url].]
